name: ai-programming-book-builder
description: A tool to merge AI programming book content into a single markdown file

scripts.convert:styled: mkdir -p output && cd chapters && pandoc "01.1-什么是AI编程.md" -o "../output/temp.docx" -f markdown -t docx --standalone && cd .. && python3 fix-docx-styles.py "output/temp.docx" "output/01.1-什么是AI编程-styled.docx" && rm "output/temp.docx"
scripts.convert:test: mkdir -p output && node preprocess-md.js "style-test-template.md" "output/temp-test-preprocessed.md" && pandoc "output/temp-test-preprocessed.md" -o "output/temp-test.docx" -f markdown -t docx --standalone && python3 fix-docx-styles.py "output/temp-test.docx" "output/style-test-styled.docx" && rm "output/temp-test.docx" "output/temp-test-preprocessed.md"
scripts.debug:styles: mkdir -p output && pandoc "style-test-template.md" -o "output/debug-test.docx" -f markdown -t docx --standalone && python3 debug-docx-styles.py "output/debug-test.docx"
scripts.convert:codebuddy: mkdir -p output && cd chapters && node ../preprocess-md.js "03.7-CodeBuddy.md" "temp-03.7-CodeBuddy-preprocessed.md" && pandoc "temp-03.7-CodeBuddy-preprocessed.md" -o "../output/temp-03.7-CodeBuddy.docx" -f markdown -t docx --standalone && cd .. && python3 fix-docx-styles.py "output/temp-03.7-CodeBuddy.docx" "output/03.7-CodeBuddy-styled.docx" && rm "output/temp-03.7-CodeBuddy.docx" "chapters/temp-03.7-CodeBuddy-preprocessed.md"
scripts.convert:all-styled: mkdir -p output && for file in chapters/*.md; do basename="$(basename "$file" .md)"; cd chapters && pandoc "$(basename "$file")" -o "../output/temp-$basename.docx" -f markdown -t docx --standalone && cd .. && python3 fix-docx-styles.py "output/temp-$basename.docx" "output/$basename-styled.docx" && rm "output/temp-$basename.docx"; done
